group.Description: Depth electrode (shank) name: NWB ElectrodeGroup of the contact (electrodes.group_name).

location_label.Description: Anatomical label given by the authors in NWB electrodes.location (abbreviations as in the source, e.g. AMY amygdala, HIPP hippocampus, INS insula, THAL ANT anterior thalamus, WM white matter; EXCLUDE = contact excluded by the authors). Not coordinates; the source gives no electrode coordinates (x/y/z are NaN).

source_electrode_row.Description: Row index of this contact in the NWB electrodes table.
